templates.title: First contact
templates.body: Hi [name], Caleb from Earthed Energy. Got your enquiry re solar for [suburb]. Free consult, I come to you. Best time to call?

templates.title: Quote nudge
templates.body: [name], following up on the quote sent Monday. Any questions?

templates.title: Site visit booking
templates.body: Just booking in the site visit for [date] at [address]. Anything you'd like me to bring for a first look?

templates.title: Consult confirmation
templates.body:
Hi [name],

Confirming your free consult on [date] at [address]. I will bring a shade tool, a meter reader and a couple of recent quotes for similar homes so you can see real numbers.

If you have a recent power bill handy, that is the one thing that speeds everything up.

Caleb
Earthed Energy · 3 Rankine St, Strathalbyn

templates.title: Quote follow-up · day 3
templates.body:
Hi [name],

Quick check-in on the quote from earlier this week. Two things people usually ask at this point: how the battery behaves in a blackout, and what the payback looks like on your actual bill. Happy to walk through either on a 10-minute call.

Caleb

templates.title: Quote follow-up · day 10
templates.body:
Hi [name],

No pressure at all. The quote is valid for 30 days and pricing on the panels is holding. If timing has changed on your end, let me know and I will park it until you are ready.

Caleb

templates.title: Post-install thanks + review
templates.body:
Hi [name],

Thanks for having us on the roof this week. The system is live and monitoring is on your phone. Check the app in a few days and you will see the first full-sun day.

If you have two minutes, a Google review helps the next family in [suburb] find us: https://g.page/earthedenergy/review

Caleb

templates.title: Referral request · 60 days
templates.body:
Hi [name],

Two months in. How is the system tracking against the old bill?

If a neighbour or mate is thinking about solar or a battery, send them my number. Anyone you refer gets the same install crew and the same price you paid, and I will send you $200 once their system is switched on.

Caleb
